name: Using External Workflows as Tools in n8n
description: Demonstrates how to use external workflows as tools within n8n.

source.path: Other_Integrations_and_Use_Cases/Using External Workflows as Tools in n8n.json

setup: "Execute Workflow Trigger" (executeWorkflowTrigger) started the original; run this workflow on demand, through the workflow API, or add a schedule.

hints: The original was a sub-workflow called by another workflow; pass its inputs as run inputs.
"FireCrawl" authenticated with httpHeaderAuth in the original; add the matching Authorization header (or use the service's connector).
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect firecrawl: `cdecli credential create -n "firecrawl" -p firecrawl --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).

notes:
## Send URL got Crawl
This can be reused by Ai Agents and any Workspace to crawl a site. All that Workspace has to do is send a request:

```json
 {
 "url": "Some URL to Get"
 }
```
